close_reason: Rewritten: SessionClient+5 methods+5 Params → pure helpers (constants, filter builders, /changes classifiers). Deps reduced to jmap-metadata-types+serde_json. 29 tests pass (20 unit + 9 doctests). Commit c449611.
description:
Complete rewrite of jmap-metadata-client to align with draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02.

**What changes:**
- DELETE: All 5 standalone client methods (metadata_get, metadata_set, metadata_query, metadata_query_changes, metadata_changes)
- DELETE: MetadataChangesParams (standalone /changes filter args filterRelatedType + filterMetadataType no longer exist)
- DELETE: SessionClient wrapper (no standalone Metadata/* capability to bind to)
- ADD: MetadataSessionExt trait (or similar) — provides helpers for metadata-augmented requests on existing types. E.g. methods to include metadata/privateMetadata in properties lists, to build MetadataTextMatch filter conditions, to set ignoreMetadataOnlyChanges on /changes requests
- ADD: Response helpers — parse updatedProperties from /changes responses when metadata capability is active

**Spec reference:** draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §2.4, §2.5

**Architecture:** Since -02 metadata is accessed through existing type methods (Email/get, Mailbox/set, etc.), the client library becomes a helper layer rather than a standalone method provider. Consumers add metadata properties to their existing /get properties lists and metadata filters to their existing /query filter conditions. The client helpers make this ergonomic without requiring consumers to hand-build JSON.
title: Rewrite jmap-metadata-client for -02 architecture
